node.title: Re^4: Fastest way to "pick without replacement"
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Anyway in my experience you are doing micro-optimization here

This was mostly to satisfy my curiosity and perhaps provide an interesting challenge, I'm not really optimizing anything - I always had a gut feeling that [doc://splice] might be kind of slow (and it probably still is on very large arrays), so it's nice to see that in this test it's actually quite the opposite.
